description: This file contains utility functions for parsing, manipulating, and interacting with URLs and hostnames, including appending query parameters, extracting host info, and URL normalization.

classes.name: QueryIterator
classes.description: A class to iterate over key-value pairs in the query component of a URL.

methods.name: AppendQueryParameter
methods.description: Creates a new URL by appending a query parameter with proper escaping.

methods.name: AppendOrReplaceQueryParameter
methods.description: Creates a new URL by appending or replacing a query parameter, with optional removal.

methods.name: AppendOrReplaceRef
methods.description: Creates a new URL by appending or replacing the URL fragment.

methods.name: QueryIterator::GetKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the current query parameter.

methods.name: QueryIterator::GetValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the current query parameter.

methods.name: GetValueForKeyInQuery
methods.description: Finds the value for a given key in the URL's query string.

methods.name: ParseHostAndPort
methods.description: Splits a host:port string into host and port components.

methods.name: GetHostAndPort
methods.description: Returns host:port string for a URL.

methods.name: GetHostAndOptionalPort
methods.description: Returns host with optional port if default port is omitted.

methods.name: GetSuperdomain
methods.description: Returns the superdomain by removing the leftmost label.

methods.name: IsSubdomainOf
methods.description: Checks if one domain is a subdomain of another.

methods.name: CanonicalizeHost
methods.description: Returns a canonicalized host string and fills host info.

methods.name: IsCanonicalizedHostCompliant
methods.description: Checks if a host complies with RFC 1738 rules.

methods.name: IsHostnameNonUnique
methods.description: Checks if a hostname is non-unique or non-assignable.

methods.name: IsLocalhost
methods.description: Determines if a URL's host is a localhost.

methods.name: HostStringIsLocalhost
methods.description: Checks if a host string is localhost or local IP.

methods.name: SimplifyUrlForRequest
methods.description: Removes user info and reference from URL for network requests.

methods.name: ChangeWebSocketSchemeToHttpScheme
methods.description: Converts ws/wss schemes to http/https schemes.

methods.name: GetIdentityFromURL
methods.description: Extracts username and password from URL.

methods.name: HasGoogleHost
methods.description: Checks if URL's host is a Google server.

methods.name: IsGoogleHost
methods.description: Checks if a host string is a Google server.

methods.name: IsGoogleHostWithAlpnH3
methods.description: Checks if Google host supports H3 via DNS record.

methods.name: IsLocalHostname
methods.description: Checks if host is a local hostname.

methods.name: UnescapePercentEncodedUrl
methods.description: Unescapes percent-encoded URL components.
